name: Guánica (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Five alternating wavy stripes of blue and yellow for Guánica Bay, charged at the centre with a blue oval bearing a yellow fort, from the municipal shield.
history: Guánica is a town and municipality on the Caribbean coast of southern Puerto Rico, where United States troops landed on 25 July 1898. The five waves of blue and yellow represent Guánica Bay and are taken from the municipal shield.

features.role: five wavy stripes of blue and yellow for Guánica Bay
